name: Meeting - Room Release After Meeting

parameters.query: UPDATE mtg_bookings SET status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE status = 'CONFIRMED' AND end_time < NOW() AND end_time > NOW() - INTERVAL '20 minutes' AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id, room_id, title;
